content:
maya: Nightly link-scan flagged 8 broken URLs across the KB. Quick digest so we can triage async before standup. Can folks claim what they can take? I can mop up leftovers later today. :coffee:

maya: Findings (short):
- /docs/runtime/batching.md -> 404 on image: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/batch-diagram.png
- /handbook/oncall -> dead anchor #escalation (page OK)
- /docs/dedicated/limits.md -> example curl -> 404 gist
- /docs/optimize/cache.md -> dead internal shortlink (short.redwood/run-caches)
- /docs/localization/ja/getting-started -> staging 503 for screenshots
- /docs/console/tracing.md -> orphan anchor fragment #examples
- /runbooks/incident-postmortems -> two image 403s
- /guides/model-onboarding -> outdated snippet referencing old S3 path

maya: Quick notes: most are simple rehosts or anchor fixes. A couple need owner confirmation (runbooks + handbook). If you add "taking" below I’ll add you to the checklist and watch for the PR.

sam: taking /docs/runtime/batching.md and /docs/optimize/cache.md. Will rehost diagram to new CDN path and swap shortlink.

lee: I can do the runbooks image rehost (403). ps — do we have a preferred rehost location?

pavan: re: preferred rehost: use assets-redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/docs/2026/ ; make sure to update CORS header comment in PR.

rachel: I’ll pick up /docs/dedicated/limits.md curl gist replacement and update the sample output.

joseph: @maya could you drop the scan output csv? easier to bulk-assign.

maya: pasted the minimal CSV below for copy/paste into the checklist:```
path,issue,type
/docs/runtime/batching.md,missing_image,media
/handbook/oncall,dead_anchor,anchor
/docs/dedicated/limits.md,404_gist,code_snippet
/docs/optimize/cache.md,dead_shortlink,link
/docs/localization/ja/getting-started,staging_503,render
/docs/console/tracing.md,orphan_anchor,anchor
/runbooks/incident-postmortems,403_images,media
/guides/model-onboarding,outdated_s3_snippet,code_snippet
```

maya: tagging owners in checklist now. Standup ask: if you claim, please open a small PR (no more than a couple commits) and ping here with PR link. If you need help with the rehost path or perms ping @eng-infra.

docs-bot: nightly-link-scan v2 completed — 8 failures detected — report https://internal-reports.redwood.ai/scan/1752468000 (automated).

sam: quick note — rehosted batch diagram to https://assets-redwood.s3.amazonaws.com/docs/2026/batch-diagram-20260322.png ; opening PR in a few mins: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 :thumbsup:

lee: opening PR for runbooks images now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4822 — rehost + update alt text. cc @pavan for CORS check.

rachel: PR for gist swap is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4823 — replaced gist with inline snippet and updated output.

pavan: @lee confirmed CORS headers look good on the bucket. LGTM to merge once CI passes.

maya: awesome, thanks all. I’ll sweep the remaining two (handbook anchor + console tracing fragment) after standup if nobody picks them up. :eyes:
